description.zh: 流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
推流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
> - 可以通过调用 DescribeLiveUserDomains API获取可用域名列表。
description.en:
The ingest domain.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the required permissions on the domain name.
> - You can call the DescribeLiveUserDomains operation to query available domain names.

description.zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > > - EndTime要大于StartTime，并且EndTime与StartTime间隔最多为30天
description.en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). > > - EndTime must be later than StartTime, and the interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days.
The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

description.zh: 流的名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the stream. You can view StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

title.zh: 查询RTMP协议直播流的帧率和码率
title.en: Query frame rates and bitrates of an RTMP live stream

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口查询RTMP协议的直播流在设置时间范围内的一组帧率和码率，适用于获取历史数据。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Queries the frame rates and bitrates of an RTMP live stream within a specified time range. This operation is applicable to retrieving historical data.


## QPS limit
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per user for this operation is 50. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as appropriate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-bit-rate-data --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamBitRateData --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --AppName liveApp0000
